summary: Review-only IS-A-to-intermediate and intermediate-to-FS-A paths were constructed and passed numeric, VTST, periodic-branch, and visual structure checks; both remain unsubmitted and their checksum-bound path reviews await user acceptance.

payload.objective: Obtain user acceptance or rejection of two concrete split paths before any GPU or VASP calculation is prepared or submitted.
current_evidence: Segment 1 uses 7 internal images (9 structures total) for H49 surface-site rearrangement from IS-A to the independently converged intermediate; O-H remains nonbonded and the largest adjacent atom step is 0.613632 A.
Segment 2 uses 9 internal images (11 structures total) through reviewed O-H targets 2.20, 1.70, 1.30, and 1.10 A; O-H decreases monotonically from 2.669336 to 0.981210 A.
Both segments preserve atom order, the common cell, bottom Fe indices 0-17, and a sequential minimum-image periodic branch; no collision or chemistry-window failure was found.
VTST dist.pl and nebmovie.pl 0 completed for both candidates. Maximum adjacent dist.pl values are 0.635859 A for segment 1 and 0.527847 A for segment 2.
Top- and side-view montages were visually inspected. Segment 1 shows a continuous surface H migration and segment 2 shows continuous H lift/O-H formation with smooth adsorbate reorientation.
The rejected v1/v2 waypoint constructions were not used because independent endpoint-vector interpolation compressed C1-C2 to 1.17-1.22 A; v3 preserves the adsorbate bond-tree lengths.
These are kinematic path candidates only. No ML/VASP forces, path energies, TS, or barrier are established.
payload.one_executable_step: Present both concrete path montages and geometry tables for user approval or rejection; do not prepare or submit GPU, VASP NEB, Dimer, frequency, or barrier work in the same step.
payload.submission_boundary: No calculation submission is authorized. Both path_review_draft.json files remain status needs_review with no reviewer or acceptance timestamp.
done_when: The user accepts or rejects each split path.
Only after separate calculation authorization may an accepted checksum-bound path enter the applicable execution gate.
